text.p: These are the leading stories in the Namibian press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Namibian Police Drug Enforcement Unit arrested a woman carrying cocaine with a street value of more than N$1.4 million at Windhoek international airport on Tuesday. It was the unit's third major cocaine bust and the result of close cooperation with customs officials at Frankfurt International Airport in Germany.

- Construction company Stocks & Stocks won a legal victory on Thursday, when the High Court dismissed an application for the withdrawal of a tender for the building of a government office park, that was awarded to the Stocks and Stocks in May last year. The building contract has a value of N$235 million.

- Namibia's only deep water port at Walvis Bay celebrated an historic day last Wednesday with the arrival of the container ship "Cornelia Maersk", marking the start of a regular container freight service by the Danish Maersk company.
